visibleTestCases.title: Asynchronous Worker Report Offload
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, S} = async_report_server:start_link(), Res = async_report_server:generate_report(S, "rep_1", fun() -> 42 * 2 end), async_report_server:stop(S), Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Worker computes 84 and delivers reply directly via gen_server:reply/2.

visibleTestCases.title: Process Hibernation Verification
visibleTestCases.erlangCall: begin {ok, S} = async_report_server:start_link(), Res = async_report_server:hibernate_idle(S), async_report_server:stop(S), Res end
visibleTestCases.explanation: Puts idle gen_server into compact heap hibernation.
